# iCreatePDF

> Free, 100% private, client-side PDF suite and visual automation studio. All document processing runs locally in browser WebAssembly memory without uploading files to any server.

iCreatePDF (https://icreatepdf.com) provides 132+ professional web tools to manipulate, convert, optimize, redact, sign, and automate PDF documents with zero cloud uploads, zero account requirements, and complete privacy.

## Core Capabilities
- [Visual Workflow Automation](https://icreatepdf.com/en/workflow): Node-based drag-and-drop studio to chain multiple PDF tools (e.g., input -> watermark -> compress -> AES-256 encrypt -> export) in an automated local pipeline.
- [All PDF Tools Directory](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools): Complete master directory of 132+ client-side PDF tools.
- [Merge PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents in custom sequence locally without size limits.
- [Compress PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size up to 80% while retaining vector crispness and text layers.
- [Split PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/split-pdf): Extract custom page ranges or split documents into separate single-page files.
- [Edit PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/edit-pdf): Visual canvas editor for adding annotations, text, images, and shapes to existing PDFs.
- [Protect PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/protect-pdf): Secure documents with AES-256 password protection and permission locks.
- [Unlock PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove passwords and permissions from encrypted PDF documents locally.
- [PDF to Word (DOCX)](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/pdf-to-docx): Convert PDF files into editable Microsoft Word documents.
- [Word to PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert DOC and DOCX files into standardized PDF documents.
- [JPG to PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into compiled multi-page PDFs.
- [PDF to JPG](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Export PDF pages as high-resolution image files.
- [OCR PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/ocr-pdf): Extract text and make scanned documents searchable using Tesseract.js WebAssembly.
- [Sign PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/sign-pdf): Apply draw, type, or image-based electronic signatures without cloud storage.
- [Watermark PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/watermark-pdf): Stamp custom confidential text or image watermarks with precise opacity and angle.
- [Find & Redact](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/find-and-redact): Permanently black out confidential numbers, names, and sensitive patterns.

## Tool Categories
- [Organize & Manage](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/organize-manage): Tools for merging, splitting, rotating, deleting, and reordering pages.
- [Optimize & Repair](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/optimize-repair): Tools for compression, grayscale conversion, flattening, and corruption repair.
- [Convert to PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/convert-to-pdf): Convert Office documents, images, markdown, and text to PDF.
- [Convert from PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/convert-from-pdf): Convert PDF files to images, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and HTML.
- [Edit & Annotate](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/edit-annotate): Annotations, page numbering, Bates stamping, redaction, and cropping.
- [Security & Privacy](https://icreatepdf.com/en/tools/category/secure-pdf): AES encryption, password removal, electronic signatures, and certificate seals.

## Guides & Tutorials
- [How to Merge PDF Files Free](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-merge-pdf-files-online-free): Complete step-by-step guide on assembling multi-file documents.
- [Compress PDF Without Quality Loss](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-compress-pdf-without-losing-quality): Technical guide on vector preservation and DPI optimization.
- [Complete PDF Security Guide](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/complete-guide-to-pdf-security-and-password-protection): Understanding AES-256 encryption, permissions, and metadata sanitization.
- [Offline PDF Privacy Architecture](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/offline-pdf-tools-privacy-guide): Why browser-based WebAssembly is safer than cloud file converters.
- [How to Edit PDF Text Online](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-edit-pdf-text-and-images-online-free): Tutorial on modifying existing text, images, and shapes in PDF.
- [How to Sign PDF Documents](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-electronically-sign-pdf-documents-online): E-signing contracts and forms with legal validity client-side.
- [How to OCR Scanned PDFs](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-ocr-scanned-pdf-to-searchable-text): Making scanned documents searchable using client-side OCR.
- [How to Convert Images to PDF](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-convert-jpg-and-images-to-pdf): Combining JPG/PNG photos into structured PDF documents.
- [Permanently Redact PDF Info](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-permanently-redact-sensitive-info-in-pdf): Irreversibly blacking out confidential numbers and text.
- [PDF Multi-Tool Master Guide](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/mastering-the-all-in-one-pdf-multi-tool-workspace): All-in-one visual studio for merging, splitting, and organizing.
- [Remove Blank Pages from Scanned PDFs](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-automatically-remove-blank-pages-from-pdf): Intelligent client-side removal of empty scan sheets.
- [Extract Images from PDF Files](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-extract-images-from-pdf-files): Export original-resolution photos and diagrams from documents.
- [Convert Color PDF to Grayscale](https://icreatepdf.com/en/blog/how-to-convert-color-pdf-to-grayscale-black-and-white): Monochrome conversion to save printer toner and compress files.
